mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past three months signals an active monetary easing cycle, which reduces discount rates for equity valuations and drives positive forward returns in the S&P 500 over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive during periods of declining FEDFUNDS (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A labor market contraction, indicated by a 0.3 percentage point increase in the unemployment rate over three months, signals weakening demand and reduced corporate pricing power, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances where UNRATE increases by >0.3pp over 3 months, or the signal fails to outperform baseline in 3-year rolling walk-forward tests.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in both residential construction (HOUST) and real personal consumption (RSAFS) signals a broad-based weakening in aggregate demand, which triggers a sell-off in equities due to lower expected corporate earnings over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in HOUST and RSAFS fails to predict negative 60-day SPX returns (Rank IC < 0.03), or the interaction effect is not statistically significant (p > 0.05) in 3-year rolling walk-forward tests.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained drop in industrial production (INDPRO) below its 12-month moving average, combined with a concurrent rise in unemployment (UNRATE), indicates a supply-side shock that disrupts production and reduces corporate profitability, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO < 12mo MA and UNRATE rises > 0.2pp in 3 months
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are not significantly negative during triggered instances (t-test p > 0.05), or the interaction signal has Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in residential construction (HOUST) above its 12-month high, coupled with rising real personal consumption (RSAFS), signals a strong rebound in consumer demand, which boosts corporate revenue expectations and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive during co-occurrence of high HOUST and high RSAFS (t-test p > 0.05), or the interaction effect has Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A persistent rise in inflation (CPIAUCSL) above 3% year-over-year, combined with a low federal funds rate, signals that the Fed is behind the curve, increasing the risk of future rate hikes and triggering a sell-off in equities over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative during triggered instances (t-test p > 0.05), or the interaction signal fails to achieve Rank IC > 0.05 in 3-year rolling walk-forward tests.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payroll growth (PAYEMS) above 200k per month, combined with a declining unemployment rate (UNRATE), signals a tight labor market that pressures firms to raise wages and prices, leading to higher inflation expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS > 200k and UNRATE falls > 0.2pp in 3 months
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative during triggered instances (t-test p > 0.05), or the interaction signal has Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A quarterly GDP growth rate (GDPC1) below 1.5% in the most recent quarter signals a weakening economy, which reduces corporate earnings expectations and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative during periods of GDPC1 < 1.5% (t-test p > 0.05), or the signal has Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
